subject: [PATCH v2 3/6] NFSD: Document per-export read_io= and write_io= options

2026-10-29.patch_summary: This patch adds documentation for two new export options in the NFS server: read_io= and write_io=. These options allow administrators to set the I/O mode for each export independently, overriding global settings. The options accept three values: buffered, dontcache, or direct, with the same meanings as their corresponding debugfs values. The patch also explains how these per-export settings interact with global knobs and are reported in /proc/net/rpc/nfsd.export/content.
